parse.title: Gamer Girl (Flash)
parse.text:
Overview

Gamer Girl (Flash) is a ​MythicalMythical​ unit. She can only be obtained by evolving Gamer Girl.

Evolving

Gamer Girl (Flash) can be evolved from Gamer Girl with the following materials:

Required Items: x1 Gamer Girl
x4 Ice Crystallite
x4 Dark Crystallite
x2 Blood Crystallite
x4 Star Fruit
x1 Star Fruit (Blue)
x1 Star Fruit (Red)
x1 Star Fruit (Pink)
x1 Star Fruit (Rainbow)
Result
Gamer Girl (Flash)

Before evolving this unit, the unit must have 7500 Takedowns. [1]

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.
